steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We're here. This path... connects the palace and the ducal manor.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: (Whispers) ...Golden mane.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: What did you just say, Vina?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No, it's nothing. It's been a long time since I saw them.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Not long ago, we left this place. Today, we walk these ancient bricks again. This path has likely never been trodden this frequently.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It was only meant for emergencies.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Too bad. Be it the ducal manor or the palace, it has never really served anyone in their time of need.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Mercenary, if you don't want to buy everyone here a drink, you'd better not joke about that.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Right then.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale, you said I once came back through this passage with the Sighs of Kings...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I really don't remember that.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This has me very restless. It's as though I am purposefully avoiding a great responsibility.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Vina, it's okay. You were too young then.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Anyone who tried to force any kind of responsibility onto a child that had only just learnt to speak would have to be extraordinarily selfish. No mistake about it.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Apologies. I might have insulted someone close to you.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Hm, actually, I rather agree with what you said.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But now, we've come back nonetheless.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: 'Responsibility'? 'Miracles'? I have no idea what they expected of me, nor do I really care.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But I stand here today, and I have something I must accomplish.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I shan't take on any titles because of it. I'm doing this... so that the people will know peace again.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Hah... We are approaching our objective, then.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Sirs, please tear down the brick wall blocking the path up ahead. Be quiet. Don't let them find us.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We need to go down from here...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Right, I...

a.text: As I walk through the darkness, I hear footsteps from behind me.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: What's the matter, Vina?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Never mind. Let's keep going.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: No one on our tail.

steps.name: Victorian Mercenary
steps.text: The Sarkaz couldn't have figured we would go down.

steps.name: Victorian Mercenary
steps.text: They must be throwing quite the party above us.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's possible that our allies are sacrificing their lives in this intense battle.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I was actually apprehensive when Allerdale proposed this plan.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I should be standing with the Corps fighters... and the Rhodes Islanders.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The Doctor's plan is meant to ensure our operation remains undetected.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: No matter what happens aboveground, we must get our hands on the Sighs of Kings.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It is the key to foiling the Sarkaz's plans and can even turn the tide of the war.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: This sword... I've only heard of it in the stories.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It was the sword of the Aslan forefathers.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: As the legend goes, it was forged for the Aslans by the fairy of the grasslands. A pasha of yore once beheaded the Poltergeist King with it.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Then, the Aslans came to Victoria to rule, and it became the symbol of their reign.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: According to some historical records, in the days before the nomadic cities came to be, the kings once cleaved Catastrophes with it.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: For centuries, there was not a single storm to threaten Londinium.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The masses believed that as long as the Sighs of Kings remains, Londinium would overcome all her foes forever, be they powerful poltergeists or terrifying Catastrophes.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You can't really believe...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I do.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I... I believe in Vina.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: It's like you're trying to change the subject. Of course I believe in Vina too, but you can tell right away it's just a fairy tale. That's not real...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: That is in fact not a fabrication to legitimize the Aslans' reign. It really can cleave Catastrophes.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: If The Shard, with its ability to pull in storms, is Victoria's spear against the outside world, then the Sighs of Kings, capable of rending Catastrophes asunder, is its strongest shield.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The spear is known far and wide, yet the shield exists almost only in legend.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: But if we are able to wield this power, we will almost certainly be able to stop the Sarkaz's ambitions.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale, you're very familiar with our Realmblade.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I... I'm only fulfilling my responsibilities as a member of House Cumberland.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Have you seen the blade with your own eyes?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Yes, but only once.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: What I saw... was something that could only happen in a dream.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: What did the blade look like?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It... It was beautiful.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It has the power to liven one's heart. The moment you lay your eyes upon it, you'll believe from the pit of your soul that you can triumph over anything.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: A bit over the top, innit?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Legends... Legends...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Maybe that's about the Sarkaz? Is that sword especially good at cutting Sarkaz?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Is cutting all you think about?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: If Vina had beaten that Sanguinarch bloody with her hammer the other day, it'd have a story like that in two hundred years.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Haha, that just might happen.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Then Rhodes Island will become the fairy that bestowed the hammer.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Closure'll probably be happy about that.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: 'The Ark of God in the barrenlands! The return of the king!'

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: How's that a story? It's all real!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: In twenty years, the story of the 'Great King Vina, leading the Londiniers to chase out the King of Sarkaz' is bound to become a favorite story of all the kids that run around in front of our houses!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Then I've got to spend some time thinking how to better tell Vina's story... Hm...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This isn't my story.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The bold, fearless Hannah 'Indra' Jackson, the witty Kate Morrigan, and the loyal, tenacious Isabelle Montague.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Also... the noble, upright Allerdale Cumberland.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This is your story.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Let's keep going.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The story isn't going to write itself.
Kyngasycath, the Sighs of Kings.
In her heart, Siege thinks to herself that she must have seen it before.
They are only vague fragments of memories and unclear voices.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: My daughter, come. Take this sword.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: Is it calling to you?

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: Feel it.

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: Feel this voice...

steps.name: Impassioned Voice
steps.text: Feel Victoria.
The palace is burning.
She wants to climb up and see what kind of show they are putting on outside. Things are always very lively on the king's birthday.
But all she sees is fire. The fire rages. There are also many men in uniform, either fleeing in all directions away from the flames or lying lifelessly on the ground.

The earth trembles. She's suddenly worried about the glass fowlbeast by her bed. It's a gift that she has just received. Lately, she hasn't been able to sleep without hugging that delicate little trinket.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Her Royal Highness Alexandrina!

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Don't go back! It's dangerous! Thank goodness you ran outside! You're their only objective, aside from His Majesty...

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: His Majesty... His Majesty has...

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: No, you needn't know this.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: He left us with one final order. To get you away.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Vina, what's wrong? You've been rather out of it since we came underground.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I... I remembered something. Something that I thought I'd forgotten long ago.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The kind that hurts to remember, or the kind that brings you joy?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's just... a voice.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Your Highness... you must walk the rest of the way on your own.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: You were here not too long ago. You remember, don't you?

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: They're coming for us.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: No matter what happens, you must keep running down this passage.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Do not turn back.

a.text: She listens to the officer and keeps running.
The path ahead is pitch-black, but she is more afraid of the star-like glow chasing her from behind.

She runs and runs for a long, long time. She's forgotten where she started and where she is going. She's almost cried all the tears she has, and the path before her is so long that she can't see its end.
She runs and runs, and a huge, golden mane appears beneath her.
She holds tight to the warm, golden color, and it feels as though she too has become a wild beast dashing on all fours.
At last, she no longer fears the nightmare that chases her. She cries for the things she has lost no more. Instead, she dashes forward freely in the darkness.

steps.text: The phantoms have disappeared, and the memories recede like the tide.
She finds herself standing in the middle of a long path.
At the end of the path is a door. The door divides life and death, and whether it leads from life to death or from death to life, it opens only to the King of Victoria.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We're here.
